reasons: intent_insensitive: question four is no: a different enemy intent would not have changed the line, so the intent is not part of the decision

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: Powder Pop first, because the Spark bank is empty and both Spark spenders are locked out until something banks one. It costs nothing, puts a 5-damage Bomb on the Crawler, and hands me the Spark. That unlocks Ka-pow! for 7 damage at zero cost. Then Kaboom! for 1 energy and 7 more damage. That is all the damage in the hand: 14 face damage now plus the 5 from the Bomb, with Pyro applied. I still had 2 energy and nothing left that deals damage, so I spent 1 on Duck and Cover for 5 Block, which fully covers the telegraphed 4-damage attack and leaves me at 36 HP going into next turn. One energy goes unspent because nothing in hand can use it.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: Tinder Toss instead of Ka-pow! as the Spark spender. There is exactly one enemy, so the AoE clause is worth nothing and it trades 7 damage for 4 — rejected immediately. I also weighed dropping Duck and Cover, since 4 damage against 36 HP is not threatening, but the energy had no other use, so declining it would have been giving up 4 HP for nothing.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: One Spark is all this hand generates and I spent it on single-target damage, so Tinder Toss stays dead in hand — if a second enemy appears before it cycles, I have no Spark banked to fire it. I also spent Powder Pop purely as a Spark battery rather than saving it, and I left 1 energy unused. Nothing was held back for a future turn: the whole playable hand went out this turn, so next turn starts with an empty bank again.
answers.q4_different_intent: No. The damage half of the line is forced — Powder Pop is the only Spark source, Ka-pow! beats Tinder Toss against a single target, and Kaboom! is the last damage card — so no telegraph changes it. The Block half is a free roll: with 2 spare energy and no other sink, Duck and Cover is correct against a 4-damage attack, against a 40-damage attack, and against a buff or a defend intent alike. There is no intent on this board that would have moved a single card.
